name: Tessek Guava-Burnt Honey Soft Chews
description: Individually wrapped soft chews with a guava-forward synth-fruit center and a scorched honey coating that crackles slightly before giving way to the chewy interior.
flavor_profile: Tropical guava sweetness cut by bitter-edged burnt honey, with a soft caramel chew that lingers
slogan: The sweetest things are a little burnt.
cultural_context: Tessek soft chews are a childhood staple for most Tier 2-3 adults in GLMZ, and eating one is a reliably nostalgic experience. They're given to children as comfort rewards and quietly eaten by adults during stressful work periods. The 12-pack is a standard break room offering.
story_hooks: The burnt honey coating process was discontinued and reformulated two years ago to cut costs — but the new formula tastes different enough that a group of dedicated users launched a petition that has unexpectedly gained political traction.

A Tessek factory worker discovers that the guava flavoring compound is being sourced from a supplier with ties to a corponation that is aggressively buying up Shelf land, and debates whether to go public.
An investigator uses the distinctive scent of Tessek chews — detectable on breath for up to two hours — to place a suspect at a crime scene, despite the suspect's alibi.
